rootAssessment: Lead assent (Claude Opus 5.5) for RUST3-LIM: the Rust3 subject-list-by-reference successor. Under the optional token subject-scope-reference-v1, each Rust Analyze stage carries a file count and a commitment instead of the per-file subject list; host and worker rebuild the list from the snapshot manifest the worker already accepted (as TS2 does). Commitment recipes and the 32-member limits map are unchanged; the bound becomes the manifest's own 200,000 limit with snapshot2's bounds first; the token is required only above 256 files. It lifts the cap that refused 9 of the 22 T2 Rust repositories (tokio, axum, deno and others) within the current major. Binds after FA-2 (its handshake copies are FA-2's successors). GROK2 ACCEPT-DESIGN-UNIT r1, no findings.
